contracts.signal: Supplier: Tokai Carbon Korea buys its main raw material, high-purity graphite, from its parent Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. (Japan), with unit prices negotiated each year in yen; H1 raw-material purchases were graphite KRW 14,206M (95.0%) and graphite foil etc. KRW 754M (5.0%). Related-party purchases from Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. were KRW 12,569,838K in H1 2026 (H1 2025: KRW 15,699,911K) and technology royalties under a 2019 technology licence (10 years from 2019-01-01, auto-renewing) KRW 5,100,690K (KRW 3,687,442K). A sales-support fee agreement with KC Co. (2% of Solid SiC ring sales; KRW 2,988,772K in H1) was amended on 2026-03-31 to end on 2026-12-31 without renewal. Sales to group affiliate Tokai Carbon (Dalian) were KRW 5,306,338K.
